I replied to Ilse in a thread under her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, and that this replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning. I also suggested she fix that post herself.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't change or save anything else. I didn't open #north-team, so I haven't seen the date she originally posted there. The renewal date counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and she had already posted it in this channel, so repeating it there was fine.
